brands.name: Cooper Surfboards
brands.short_description: Progressive custom surfboards handmade by Ollie Cooper in Cornwall, UK since 2012.

models.name: Electric Twin
models.description: The Electric Twin is fast and responsive, while never sliding out. The modern fish outline works well with an XL upright twin fin and hybrid keel/uprights

models.name: Zero
models.description: Founded on the principles of the Two.Five and Electric Twin, this little pocket rocket is our highest peformance twin fin. A board that carries incredible speed and surfs fast in the pocket. A pronounced flat deck and chine rail carries loads of volume allowing this board to be surfed very short, while a progressive rocker line and deep single to double concave make it ultra fast and lively underfoot.  Expect fast, lively, in the pocket surfing, for those enlightened surfers looking to push twin fins to their pinnacle of performance.  Ride the Zero the same length as your fish, or 3 to 4 inches shorter than your shortboard. Loads of volume in this one, dont be afraid to go short.  Pair it with the Captain Panda Upright Twin Fins, an XL upright twin set that let's this little ripper unleash its full potential.

models.name: Sidekick
models.description: If you're looking for a board for steeper waves, that keeps loads of paddle power and allows you to push your surfing this is just the thing.

models.name: POG
models.description: The next step in the mid length evolution, the POG is a more conservative approach to getting more foam under your feet, without the 'retro' drawbacks.

models.name: Mono
models.description: Narrow, lightweight, and nimble, a performance-forward single fin that hovers between mid length and mini-glider territory.  Inspired by the lines drawn by Tudor, Knost et al.  Flat deck retains volume and paddles well for the size, teamed with a sensitive chined down rail.  Incredible range making this board an absolute swiss army knife, excels in good waves but makes easy work of anything waist high and up.  Push it as hard as you like, this board will challenge your perception of single fin possibilities.

models.name: Yonder Mini Mal
models.description: Designed in collaboration with my friends at Yonder, tuned and proven over hundreds of lessons and years of experience. Here’s what they have to say about the board:  “The first step off of a soft-top or a 'foamie' is a really important one in anyone's surfing journey. What we are looking for is a really nice neutral board that will offer us a good balance of stability and manoeuvrability for both paddling and surfing.  These boards are tried and tested; the outline, rocker, volume distribution and rails are designed specifically for solidifying the fundamentals of surfing. Nearly all of the women that have recently been on our intermediate coaching courses started, or are still surfing Yonder Mini-mals. We also use them on our surf lessons and camps too. A good Mini-mal will take a surfer from learning to get in trim, to performing some turning manoeuvres and drawing lines on the face of a wave. Great for learning the fundamental manoeuvres in surfing; bottom and top turns and up to re-directs and re-entries - this level of board will be useful for a good part of a surfers learning journey giving them a great starting chance.”  Stock dimensions - 7'6 x 22 x 2 3/4  We're spec'ing these with a three fin thruster setup with Futures fin plugs.  For every Yonder Mini Mal sold we're donating a portion of profits to the Yonder Surf Academy CIC, an initiative to inspire and support marginalised women and girls to build confidence, self-esteem and positive mental health.  Click below for the full write-up.

models.name: Perch
models.description: To settle or rest in an elevated position, as if on a perch.  A contemporary noserider designed for classic logging, the Perch provides a stable platform for cross-stepping and noseriding.  Traditonal outlines tied with our modern understanding of lift and balance. Exaggerated tail rocker, no-edge pinched 50/50 rails, and rolled bottom shape. Encourages a slow and steady approach to surfing, drawing back into the pocket while you relax up front.  To be ridden with a high aspect pivot fin from 9.75" to 10.5".

models.name: Quickstep
models.description: A versatile longboard specially made for smaller and lighter surfers. The Quickstep will noseride and trim with the best — perfect for groms, girls, and lighter riders. Cooper's do-everything longboard shape with a round concaved nose, single channel through the middle, and a rolled pulled-in tail section. Slightly narrower with a touch more blended rocker than other Cooper longboard models, but still a stable and stylish cruiser.
